title: The Twelve Judges and the Thrones of Glory
description: The Lord's discriminating presence in twelve registers and his throne-stations of glory. T28 expounds the Twelve Judges sent forth from the Father — one twelvefold articulation of divine truth's discriminating power, each register the Lord himself judging at a different depth of the rational: the Divine Human humbling the proprium, the operative power binding what wears divine garments, the life-bearing principle setting the disordered mind on its feet, the great new aeon of joy, the King of Honor, the call going out and exposing, divine truth shining and looking, and so on through the King of Glory. T29 maps the throne-stations at which the Lord is recognized as he goes forth — nine outer thrones in the aeons of Greatness mirrored by nine corresponding stations within the cosmos, with the inmost ruling alone in his own essence and every other an accommodation of him.
